title: AWS CSPM Missing Vulnerability Scan

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `aws:securityhub:findings` events with `Title="*scan*" OR Title="*vulnerab*"` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.10.8 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:securityhub:findings` traffic without `Title="*scan*" OR Title="*vulnerab*"`. Confirm UC-4.10.8 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=aws` sourcetype=`aws:securityhub:findings` collected via Cloud posture integration via provider TA; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.

description: UC-4.10.8 — AWS CSPM Missing Vulnerability Scan: queries AWS `aws:securityhub:findings` for search criteria `Title="*scan*" OR Title="*vulnerab*"` and returns actor, resource, and region context for compliance review and change validation.
value: On AWS, detecting 'AWS CSPM Missing Vulnerability Scan' early shortens cloud incident response and produces defensible audit evidence for identity and change-management controls. UC-4.10.8 drives high-priority compliance alerting before customer-impacting drift.
implementation: Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=aws:securityhub:findings.
visualization: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report.
knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Cloud posture integration via provider TA with the modular input for `aws:securityhub:findings`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.10.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `Finding.Title` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=aws:securityhub:findings.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:securityhub:findings" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:securityhub:findings" Title="*scan*" OR Title="*vulnerab*"
| table _time Finding.Title Finding.Severity.Label Finding.AwsAccountId
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.10.8_aws_cspm_missing_vulnera_8"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:securityhub:findings` in `index=aws` to detect aws cspm missing vulnerability scan. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the AWS Security Hub console Findings for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `Finding.Title` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_10_8_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Cloud posture integration via provider TA and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of aws cspm missing vulnerability scan so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
